stories.title: Queensland property market faces largest downturn in four decades
stories.summary: Queensland is experiencing its biggest property downturn in four decades. Median house values in Mansfield plunged 11.3 per cent to 1.2 million dollars, while Wishart and Stretton fell 10.4 per cent and 10.1 per cent respectively. The storm is currently weathering some suburbs better than others.

stories.title: Luxury home prices in the U.K. expected to fall in 2027
stories.summary: Savills forecasts that luxury home prices will fall across most of the U.K. in 2027 due to high borrowing costs and political uncertainty. Scotland is the only market expected to hold steady. London commuter towns are particularly exposed to the lack of capital flow.

stories.title: New Zealand records largest annual house price drop in 19 months
stories.summary: New Zealand has posted its biggest annual house price drop in 19 months. The full piece is for subscribers. The market is currently adjusting to conditions that have not been seen since early 2025.

stories.title: South Korean land minister calls for Seoul housing cooperation
stories.summary: Land Minister Hong Ji-seon has called on the Seoul Metropolitan Government to cooperate on expanding housing supply. The government aims to supply 1.5 million homes over five years. Minister Hong noted that one hand cannot clap alone, though the city has yet to provide the other.

stories.title: Democratic Party panel prioritizes housing welfare over price controls
stories.summary: A Democratic Party of Korea committee says housing policy should prioritize welfare for low and middle income households over stabilizing home prices. The committee suggests focusing on public rental housing and tenant protections. Lower prices are no longer the primary policy goal.
